title: Nova SBE Master's Scholarships and Awards (including the Nova SBE Merit Scholarship)
official_source: Nova School of Business and Economics (Nova SBE), Universidade NOVA de Lisboa
program_type: University master's tuition-fee scholarship portfolio (institutional and partner-funded)
duration: Follows the enrolled Master's programme. No programme length is published on the scholarships page read, so duration is not asserted.

title: University of Porto Scholarships and Funding (SASUP, Merit and Scientific Scholarships)
program_type: University internal scholarship and financial support portfolio (study, merit and scientific scholarships)
duration: SASUP study scholarship is granted and renewed annually; scientific scholarships 'as a rule' run annually and are extendable up to three years.
description: The University of Porto promotes and sponsors financial support for its students and researchers. The three schemes named on the official page are SASUP study scholarships, awarded as a monthly cash payment by the Social Support Services of the University of Porto; U.Porto Merit Scholarships, a cash prize for students with the best academic results; and Scientific Scholarships, research scholarships for undergraduate and postgraduate students. title: Camoes, I.P. Portuguese Language and Culture Scholarships
official_source: Camões - Instituto da Cooperação e da Língua, I.P. (Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Portugal)
program_type: Government-funded language and culture scholarship programme (Ministry of Foreign Affairs budget)
duration: Annual Course scholarships last eight months and are not renewable; Summer Course scholarships last one month; the Fernão Mendes Pinto, Research, Pessoa and Vieira programmes have a variable duration and may be renewed.
description: Camões - Instituto da Cooperação e da Língua, I.P., the Portuguese Ministry of Foreign Affairs agency for external language and culture cooperation, runs a set of scholarship programmes within the Portuguese Language and Culture Scholarship Programme. The programmes support improvement of language skills, study and research in Portuguese language and culture, scientific or professional training of Portuguese as a Second Language, and training in translation and conference interpreting. title: University of Lisbon International Scholarships
program_type: University social support structure comprising state scholarships, financial aid, residences, health and academic success services
duration: DGES scholarship payments run in 10 monthly instalments per academic year; no duration is published for the university's own awards
description: The Student Support Services of Universidade de Lisboa is an autonomous service designed to carry out social action policies under the terms defined by law and by the university's governing bodies, providing and managing social services for students with the aim of ensuring equal opportunities in access, attendance and academic success regardless of socio-economic background, through direct and indirect social support and special support.

title: Canada Graduate Research Scholarship—Master's (CGRS-M)
official_source: Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council (SSHRC)
program_type: Federal research training award (Canada Graduate Research Scholarship program)
description: The Canada Graduate Research Scholarship-Master's program provides financial support to high-calibre scholars who are engaged in an eligible master's or, in some cases, doctoral programme in Canada, allowing them to concentrate more fully on their studies in their chosen fields. For the December 2026 competition SSHRC publishes an application deadline of December 1, 2026 (8:00 p.m. eastern) and a value and duration of $27,000 for 1 year. title: Canada Graduate Research Scholarship—Doctoral (CGRS-D)
official_source: Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council (SSHRC)
program_type: Federal research training award (Canada Graduate Research Scholarship program)
description: The Canada Graduate Research Scholarship-Doctoral program recognises and supports the next generation of outstanding innovators, knowledge workers, creative thinkers and researchers, providing support for a high-quality research training experience. For the October 2026 competition SSHRC publishes a value and duration of $40,000 per year for 3 years. There are two application routes: direct to SSHRC by October 19, 2026 (8:00 p.m. eastern), or through a Canadian institution, which the page warns often closes significantly earlier than the agency deadline.

title: Ontario Graduate Scholarship (OGS) - University of Toronto
official_source: School of Graduate Studies, University of Toronto / Ontario Ministry of Colleges, Universities, Research Excellence and Security
duration: Each scholarship is tenable for one year, i.e. two consecutive or three academic sessions.
description: The Ontario Graduate Scholarship program encourages excellence in graduate studies at publicly-assisted universities in Ontario and has provided merit-based scholarships to Ontario's best graduate students in all disciplines since 1975. At the University of Toronto the program is jointly funded by the Province of Ontario and the University of Toronto, and the Province allocates OGS awards to universities specifying how many each may offer annually.
